description: Add the optional office gallery global and ordered image-caption rows; preserve existing CMS tables and published snapshots.
statements:
CREATE TABLE `office_gallery_photos` (
    `_order` integer NOT NULL,
    `_parent_id` integer NOT NULL,
    `id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    `image_id` integer NOT NULL,
    `caption` text NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (`image_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null,
    FOREIGN KEY (`_parent_id`) REFERENCES `office_gallery`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
  );
